title: Vapetasia – Blueberry Parfait 100ml
description:
Vapetasia – Blueberry Parfait 100ml
Vapetasia
An enchanting mix of vanilla and custard, reaching a perfect harmony of sweet and savory now in a chubby gorilla bottle!
Delicious blueberries and whipped sweet cream yogurt layered with honey kissed granola clusters. A base of whole-milk vanilla yogurt is whipped until it’s smooth and decadently creamy. From there a generous layers of honey-kissed granola clusters and blueberries bursting with fresh juice are added. Bottled and ready to tantalize your taste buds, this gourmet vape is perfect at breakfast or while snacking on the go, it’s delicious any time of the day.
